hero.sub: AgriSaarthi watches your soil, crops and fence line day and night, then tells you exactly what to do: on the dashboard, by SMS, by phone call, in Gujarati or Hindi.

nature.title: A quiet station that never stops watching.
nature.body: One solar pole. Soil probes, a weather shield, a night camera and a siren. It keeps working through power cuts, weak networks and long nights at the edge of the farm.

about.title: We combine IoT sensors, AI vision and solar power
about.body: Farmers still decide on water, fertilizer and sprays by guesswork, and they often find out about disease, pests or animals too late. AgriSaarthi puts a lab, an agronomist and a watchman on one solar pole, and it works offline.

how.title: Three steps from soil to decision
how.body: Sensors and a camera collect data every 15–30 minutes. A rule engine and offline AI turn it into one clear action.

scan.title: Field Scan
scan.body: Soil probes read moisture, temperature, humidity, pH and EC. The IR camera and PIR sensor watch the crop and the fence line. Weather data adds rain and heat forecasts.

analysis.title: AI Analysis
analysis.body: An on-device rule engine built on ICAR and state university guidelines works out fertilizer doses, crop choices and irrigation needs. Offline AI identifies diseases, pests and wild animals.

action.title: Precision Action
action.body: The pump relay switches on only when needed, and you get exact fertilizer bags and cost. Alerts reach you on the dashboard, by SMS, by call and by voice, before damage spreads.

outcome.title: Healthy Farm
outcome.body: Less cost, less risk, more profit

detect.title: From Detection to Action
detect.body: Every alert comes with a next step. No raw numbers to decode.

detect.title: Detect
detect.body: Leaf photo, trap photo or night camera frame. The AI names the problem in seconds, even offline.

decide.title: Decide
decide.body: The rule engine weighs soil, weather and crop stage, then picks the right dose, time and method.

act.title: Act
act.body: Pump ON/OFF, fertilizer bags and cost, spray dose, siren and strobe, all in your language.

econ.title: Better economics, less chemistry
econ.body: Blanket watering and spraying waste money and harm the soil. AgriSaarthi applies inputs only where and when the field needs them.

points.one: Fertilizer in bags per acre with estimated ₹ cost, before you buy
points.two: Irrigation timed to moisture, weather and crop stage
points.three: Sell grain at the right moisture and the best mandi price

features.title: Twelve features. One station.
features.body: Every feature works from the solar station and shows up on the dashboard. Critical alerts also reach basic phones.

soil.title: Soil moisture, temperature & humidity
soil.benefit: Live readings every 15–30 min, with a “soil too dry” alert.

chemistry.title: Soil pH & salinity (EC)

fertilizer.title: Fertilizer advice with cost
fertilizer.benefit: Bags per acre and estimated ₹ cost, from ICAR + state university rules.

crop.title: Crop guidance
crop.benefit: Top 3 crops with expected profit, crops to avoid and soil tips.

disease.title: Crop disease detection
disease.benefit: Upload a leaf photo and get the disease name and treatment. Works offline.

pest.title: Pest detection
pest.benefit: Identifies the pest, recommends a dose and shows the village pest trend.

irrigation.title: Irrigation + pump control
irrigation.benefit: Uses moisture, weather, soil and crop stage. The relay switches the pump ON/OFF.

mesh.title: Self-healing Zigbee mesh
mesh.benefit: Links many stations on large farms and reroutes if one node drops.

alerts.title: Dashboard, SMS & call alerts
alerts.benefit: SMS and calls reach any basic phone, no internet needed.

voice.title: Voice in Gujarati & Hindi
voice.benefit: Advice spoken from the box speaker, on alert calls and on the dashboard.

animal.title: Wild animal alert
animal.benefit: PIR + IR night camera trigger a siren and strobe, then a call, SMS and photo.

grain.title: Grain moisture + mandi price
grain.benefit: Shows when grain is ready and where and when to sell at the best price.

faq.title: Questions farmers ask
faq.body: Can't find your answer? Call us or book a field demo.

offline.a: Yes. Disease detection, the rule engine and alerts run on the device. SMS and calls use the basic GSM network, so they work in low-signal areas.

phone.q: I only have a basic phone. Can I use it?
phone.a: Yes. All critical alerts come as SMS and voice calls in Gujarati or Hindi. The web dashboard is optional.

npk.q: How is N, P, K measured?
npk.a: pH and EC are measured by probes in a 1:2.5 soil solution. N, P and K are entered manually from your government Soil Health Card.

accuracy.q: How accurate is the disease detection?
accuracy.a: The model is trained on common crops of Gujarat and nearby states. Each result shows a confidence score and a treatment. Low-confidence results are marked for expert review.

power.q: What happens during cloudy days or power cuts?
power.a: The station has its own solar panel and battery with backup for several cloudy days. It does not depend on farm electricity.

cost.q: Where do the fertilizer costs come from?
cost.a: Doses follow ICAR and state agricultural university guidelines. Costs use current bag prices, which you can update.

mesh.q: Do I need the Zigbee mesh?
mesh.a: Only for large farms. A single station covers a typical small farm. On bigger farms, stations link up and reroute data automatically.
